name: krakend-observability
description: Generate and edit Grafana dashboards for KrakenD metrics from natural language. Bundles the Grafana MCP server (runs in Docker) and a KrakenD dashboards skill.

grafana_url.title: Grafana URL
grafana_url.description: Base URL of your Grafana, as you open it in the browser (e.g. http://localhost:3000, https://grafana.example.com, https://<stack>.grafana.net).

grafana_service_account_token.title: Grafana service account token
grafana_service_account_token.description: Token of a Grafana service account with the Editor role (Administration > Users and access > Service accounts).
